lead: A `nvs-types` test that compiles a snippet lives in `crates/nvs-types/tests/`, never beside the registry tests in `src/`.
body: An inline `mod tests` in `core_lib.rs` asks the lowered registry its questions and never sees a diagnostic, so an anchor there is for the wrong host. `crates/nvs-types/tests/common/mod.rs`'s `check_in_method`/`check_src` are the harness and `crates/nvs-types/tests/core_members.rs` owns the options-bag rules; `cargo test -p nvs-types` runs both targets, so only the fixture decides.
